scientific_integrity: Exact all-state functional-graph census, independently recomputed via two different complete algorithms; no partial enumeration described as general proof.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite-domain exact classification only for the stated eleven-vertex Herschel graph and two threshold-one synchronous three-state automata; no universal extension to other graphs or periods. title: Matched excitation-period basins on the Herschel graph despite unequal recurrent clocks
